question_or_proposition: Are the discharge limitations and monitoring requirements listed for Outfall 001 conditioned on the scope established in the authorization sentence—i.e., applicable only to discharges that fall within the authorized categories (storm runoffs from storage and production areas, once-through cooling water, cleaning water, and Artesian well water) and only during the period beginning on the permit effective date and ending upon dismantling of Outfall 001—or do those limitations and monitoring requirements apply to all flows from Outfall 001 throughout the permit term regardless of discharge category or dismantling status?
required_context: Evidence classifying evaluated discharge events or measurements by source category relative to the four authorized discharge types named in the authorization sentence
Evidence bearing on whether Outfall 001 was dismantled during Federal FY2025 and, if so, the timing of dismantling relative to evaluated monitoring periods

Part II.B (referenced by footnote (1) to the Outfall 001 requirements table) for any discharge restrictions that clarify the relationship between authorization and the listed limitations and monitoring requirements
source_locator: page 3, section part_i, Section A item 1 (Outfalls 001)
notes: The nominated span is the authorization clause that precedes and introduces the Outfall 001 limits and monitoring table via 'Such discharges shall be limited and monitored as specified below.' Resolving how that authorization scopes 'such discharges'—by discharge category and by the effective-date-through-dismantling period—would change which numeric limits apply (Purpose A), whether monitoring was required for a given period or discharge condition (Purpose B), and how to classify periods without ordinary numeric results, including potential no-discharge or not-required states (Purpose C).
